paragraphs: Rav Chaggai flogged Rabbi Yaakov of Kefar Nevurya for ruling incorrectly (see his entry). When Rav Chisda died and his son spent the night at his grave, Rav Chisda told him, “Go tell Rav Chaggai to complete his learning, for on such-and-such a day he will come here”: Tziyyoni, Vayechi.
